verdict.rationale: Modal documents an extensive public API surface for Sandboxes across Python, JS/Go SDKs, and a CLI reference (modal-docs-13,15,18,19,20,21,25), with independent community developers confirming they drove Sandboxes programmatically via gRPC/SDK for real projects (modal-comm-1, modal-comm-2). Missing for 10: a discoverable formal REST/OpenAPI spec (probe-3 shows all openapi.json candidates 404) and broader third-party API-client corroboration beyond a couple of HN posts.
